name: captured_bill_photo
description: A PHOTOGRAPHED bill (JPEG, as camera capture emits) plus its EOB. N1/C1: a captured photo must reach extraction on exactly the same path as a picked PDF — same magic-byte gate, same classifier, same audit — so camera-first intake never becomes a weaker second door. NOTE: 70551 deliberately, NOT 70553 — 70553 is a FIXTURE_MARKER (the leak tripwire), and the first dev sweep (2026-08-17) proved a scenario that uses a marker as legitimate data fails itself.
